name: Shanghai
limitations: All8 dimensions and31 subpillars reviewed, not fully measured. Five conditional60 judgments, TEC80 andLON/OPT40 give58 under original weights. Each judgment needs explicit resident, locality, continuity and materiality assumptions; rejecting any necessary assumption restores unknown and removes the centre. Administrative Shanghai, Chongming, study hospitals, multicentre cohorts and cloud-city labels are distinct from eFUA10097. A voluntary inpatient insurance responsibility is not usual basic coverage or reimbursement of a documented day-infusion pathway. No healthy-person longevity claim, ranking, reliable exclusion bounds or zero imputation.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 typhoon pump/gate operation and completed construction-risk remediation, delivered geological works and2026 scoped cooling-site inspections support protection. August2026 severe waterlogging, next-night drainage, transport interruptions and a garage-flooded household water system retain actual failures alongside deployed pumps, water supplies and recovery. Municipal totals and peripheral island losses are not localFUA losses; monitoring is not residential retrofitting.
dimensions.assumption: Accept reviewed core-area protection usually usable for target residents across10097 and continuing through cutoff. Remaining thermal/building/drainage/common-failure weaknesses after actual mitigation have not become an important persistent unmitigated constraint on ordinary life or necessary corridors. This is reversible, not a complete loss-rate measurement; extreme weather does not excuse observed failures. Reject locality/resident/continuity/materiality assumptions to restore unknown; important remaining protection constraints could support40, stronger actual protection/backup80.

dimensions.rationale: A primary prosecutor/court interview documents a fixed three-person repair group using coercive threats in2021-23 and2025 judgments, plus governance and victim-reporting barriers. Older offences are not2026 new attacks or a victim rate; arrests are not convictions. ActualTaiwan-region military exercises are regional context, not Shanghai port blockade. September2026 scoped air-defence exercises support response, not wartime shelter effectiveness or attack probability.
dimensions.assumption: Accept reviewed ordinary-service/transport execution and actual enforcement as limited evidence of comparatively limited current organized-violence impact with usable mitigation across10097, while strategic-port/finance/transport concentration and regional threats remain. Extent, ordinary-resident reach and continuity are assumptions, not safety inferred from zeroUCDP matches. Reject necessary limited-impact/locality/resident/continuity assumptions to restore unknown; important continuing organized/regional/strategic constraints could support40, broader low-impact and effective-response evidence80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 water-hotline handling, delivered risk/governance changes, multi-operator flood response, targeted cooling/evacuation cooperation and scoped2026 restoration establish execution. Primary reports admit policies hard to find/understand/use, uneven handling quality, case-load pressure and street-level authority/capability mismatches. Handling totals and performance scores are not independent resident trust or complete resolution; plans and partial recovery are not fully delivered backup.
dimensions.assumption: Accept core execution being usually reachable by target local citizens across10097 and reviewed mitigation/coordination continuing through cutoff without an important broader unmitigated institutional bottleneck. Known information-service defects are real contextual limitations, not failures of researcher access; municipal reporting and targeted participation have limited representativeness. Reject reach/locality/continuity/bottleneck assumptions to restore unknown; important residual service/recovery/right-realization constraints could support40 without requiring majority harm, stronger results/reach/backup80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 water/energy delivery, scoped water-quality monitoring,2025 urban-grid reliability and typhoon food deliveries support provision. Qingcaosha raw-water salinity events, outside supply/logistics and planned interconnections retain common-channel constraints; raw salt concentrations are not tap-water concentrations. Municipal quantities/household connections are not uniqueFUA residents, city mean per-capita income is not household median, and an actual2023 tenant electricity surcharge differs from provider tariffs.
dimensions.assumption: Accept supplier/market operation and limited municipal evidence as relevant to ordinary10097 residents and continuing through cutoff, with usually affordable necessary water/food/energy at local median income. Existing storage/dispatch mitigate salinity/external-supply constraints sufficiently for usual essential access. Planned2027/2028 interconnections are not existing alternatives; historical individual tariff harm is not a2026 population rate. Reject affordability/reach/continuity/materiality assumptions to restore unknown; actual important unmet needs/common-channel bottlenecks could support40, affordable and effective common-shock alternatives80.

dimensions.rationale: Actual2025 community delivery and scoped maternal/neonatal rescue outcomes, existing multidisciplinary/community nursing and current basic-insurance rules support care. Original2026 publication reports2024 inspections of59 anonymous tertiary hospitals,32/59 irregular assessments and27/59 inadequateVTE prevention, not patient event rates or completed remediation. A primary old single-centre stroke study retains pandemic delays and conflicting588 versus558 totals. A scoped cancer reimbursement alongside severe self-pay costs is neither a complete net bill nor median-resident affordability.
dimensions.assumption: Accept lawful continuous usual basic insurance/approved alternative registration and applicable provider/catalogue/clinical conditions for the target resident; long-term Chinese citizenship is not Shanghai hukou or automatic coverage. Actual multiprovider necessary care, usually adequate quality and timely affordable alternatives remain reversible inferences despite retained nursing/process/payment weaknesses. Do not presume remediation complete or multiply gross averages by payment rates. Reject qualification/usual-quality/affordability/alternative/locality/continuity assumptions to restore unknown; important unrelieved clinical/wait/payment bottlenecks could support40 without majority harm, broader outcomes and effective pressure backup80.

dimensions.rationale: Credible shared early-Alzheimer human/regulatory pathway connects to actualHuashan/multicentre clinical use and a primaryTongren day-infusion observation. The national407-starting/405-followed cohort has39/321ARIA,4/321symptomaticARIA and15 mixed subjective withdrawals including economic/transport reasons, not all local or all financial. Its uncontrolled182 six-month subset has112MMSE/72CDR/46ADL assessments with no significantFDR-adjusted change, not proved efficacy. Current2026 supplementary policy excludes under24-hour admissions from inpatient responsibility and its50-drug special catalogue lacks these antibodies; it cannot be presumed to pay the observed day pathway.
dimensions.assumption: Accept the documented day-treatment/payment mismatch and observed economic/transport constraints as an important resident-access break for clinically eligible median-income ordinary citizens across10097, relevant to limitedLON readiness and continuing after available mitigation through cutoff. National study withdrawals are not exactShanghai or median-resident counts, and other insurance/assistance paths are not proved absent. Locality, relevance, appropriate monitoring, target affordability and residual materiality remain reversible assumptions; rejecting one restores unknown. Actual sufficiently affordable outpatient or clinically appropriate covered inpatient alternatives could support60; multiple mature accessible paths80. Approval, available infusions or a voluntary inpatient benefit do not prove ordinary access; no healthy-person lifespan benefit.

dimensions.rationale: Multiple university/industry transfers, operating digital infrastructure, deployed services and completed resident assistance support sustained production and diffusion. Institutional/global totals and connections are not all local products or unique residents; current financing/skill/activation barriers remain. OpenAlex associations are only a research-sequencing signal and anomalous printed statistical fields are not silently repaired or used to rank.
dimensions.assumption: Accept actual multiproducer capabilities and broad service use/assistance as reasonably representative of10097 main knowledge/industry activity and ordinary-resident diffusion, continuing through cutoff. After delivered mitigation, remaining funding/skill/group barriers do not form an important overall diffusion break. Reject locality/user/continuity/materiality assumptions to restore unknown; justified important residual barriers could support60. No instant substitution or independent pressure test is required at everyTEC node; cross-border restrictions are considered inOPT instead of mechanically deducted twice.

dimensions.rationale: Operating transport and the shared qualified Chinese-citizen German skilled-work national-visa path provide actual channels. Genuine current-account transfers and conditional emigrant property transfer mitigate capital-purpose/settlement-order restrictions; USD50000 is not an all-transfer ceiling. OriginalShanghai-labelled cloud measurements retain selective cross-borderTLS restrictions alongside measured unblocked same-region paths; they are not domestic-all-Internet shutdowns or resident outage rates. Applications, institutional wires and directory points are not approvals or universal relocation ability.
dimensions.assumption: Accept capital-purpose/settlement-order and actual cross-border restrictions as important to ordinary citizens initial-relocation assets and essential connections despite strong transport, lawful current payments and eventual compliant transfer. Qualification/employer/insurance/visa requirements are not assumed met. Cloud-city location/household relevance, temporal continuity and residual materiality need explicit assumptions; rejecting necessary applicability restores unknown. Actual adequately mitigated ordinary migration/assets/communication could support60, stronger usable alternatives80. This is not a national-governance proxy, reliable exclusion bound or claim residents cannot leave.

researchPriority.rule: All9031 candidates sorted by descending qualifying core nonretracted article-ID directory associations, then numeric efua_id; skip18 registered reviews only for research sequencing. No output/quality score, eligibility or exclusion.

referenceBoundaryCheck.method: Checksum-validated full9031 GHS-FUA load; EPSG4326 to ESRI54009 always_xy point intersection.

sharedLegalPath.meaning: Normally pre-entry national-visa and qualifying skilled-work residence purpose, distinct from section41(1) onshore application convenience. No automatic ordinary-resident qualification, approval, affordability or OPT score.
